recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-5530 unless Patient Care later decides to change the Flag alias set.
issue_request: FHIR-5530 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Patient Care change request for FHIR-core-Flag asking to add "Barriers to Care" as an alias for the Alert resource name.
initial_application: The issue was applied historically by SVN revision 4747, imported as git commit 39fd51792d3c3efa7cae5766d5a664f5f4b9c28c with message "#5530 - add alias to Alert". That commit added "Barriers to Care" to source/alert/alert-spreadsheet.xml, and later source refactors preserved the alias on the current Flag StructureDefinition.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists flag=Flag and records that Alert became Flag in the deleted-resource notes. Exact FHIR-5530 Zulip and Confluence searches found no direct hits, and later "Barriers to Care" community hits were general care-planning discussions rather than Flag alias decisions.
reconciliation: No source edit was necessary. source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml already includes aliases "Barriers to Care", "Alert", and "Warning" on the root Flag element, and that file feeds the active Flag resource.
